Floor area to dwellings conversion

Source: R/rulebook.R
conversion.Rd

Dwellings are a derived view of floor area. Give either one average dwelling size or a unit mix.

Usage

conversion(
  dwelling_size = NULL,
  unit_mix = NULL,
  efficiency = 1,
  min_one_dwelling = TRUE,
  min_one_dwelling_floor = NULL,
  source = NULL
)

Arguments

dwelling_size

Average gross floor area per dwelling (m2), including its share of circulation.

unit_mix

A data frame with name, size (m2) and share (summing to 1).

efficiency

Share of gross floor area that is saleable or lettable, applied before dividing by dwelling size. 1 if dwelling_size is already a gross figure.

min_one_dwelling

If TRUE, a site enabling residential floor area of at least min_one_dwelling_floor (or, if that is not set, the zone's minimum dwelling size) yields at least one dwelling.

min_one_dwelling_floor

Residential floor area (m2) at or above which a site counts at least one dwelling.

source

Citation or reasoning for the assumption.

Value

A list with class plancap_conversion.

Examples

conversion(dwelling_size = 100, source = "Assumed average")
#> $dwelling_size
#> [1] 100
#> 
#> $efficiency
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $min_one_dwelling
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $source
#> [1] "Assumed average"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "plancap_conversion"
conversion(unit_mix = data.frame(name = c("1br", "2br", "3br"),
                                 size = c(50, 75, 100),
                                 share = c(0.3, 0.5, 0.2)),
           efficiency = 0.85)
#> $unit_mix
#> $unit_mix[[1]]
#> $unit_mix[[1]]$name
#> [1] "1br"
#> 
#> $unit_mix[[1]]$size
#> [1] 50
#> 
#> $unit_mix[[1]]$share
#> [1] 0.3
#> 
#> 
#> $unit_mix[[2]]
#> $unit_mix[[2]]$name
#> [1] "2br"
#> 
#> $unit_mix[[2]]$size
#> [1] 75
#> 
#> $unit_mix[[2]]$share
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> 
#> $unit_mix[[3]]
#> $unit_mix[[3]]$name
#> [1] "3br"
#> 
#> $unit_mix[[3]]$size
#> [1] 100
#> 
#> $unit_mix[[3]]$share
#> [1] 0.2
#> 
#> 
#> 
#> $efficiency
#> [1] 0.85
#> 
#> $min_one_dwelling
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "plancap_conversion"
